institution.name: IMPA - Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada

qualifications: Register in the 'IMPA Institucional' online system
Photo (3x4) and photo ID, recommendations from at least two professors and an official transcript
Scholarship applicants: only applications submitted by 31 October with complete documentation are assured of review
Residents of Rio de Janeiro cannot apply for the scholarship
description_short: IMPA's Summer Program 2027 runs mathematics courses from 4 January to 26 February 2027. Course registration runs 15 December 2026 to 18 January 2027. A two-month local-expenses scholarship of R$ 1,200 per month is offered, with review assured only for applications by 31 October.

compensation.value: Scholarship of R$ 1,200 per month for two months (local expenses; subject to change)
